method: Retrospective task grouping of the unchanged canonical public history; not original tickets or approvals.
statusMeaning: Landed means the changes were committed in the public history through the source baseline; later tasks may supersede them. It does not mean independently accepted, fully tested or deployed.
sourceMeaning: Source commits cover each chronological landing window, including merged branches. A split window appears under multiple tasks; scopePaths identifies the files assigned to each task, not per-hunk attribution to each source commit.
